review_candidates.description: Overview Job Description Own the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of assigned services or feature areas within the professional discipline. Conduct detailed analysis and investigation to resolve difficult reliability problems involving related systems or disciplines. Define and manage SLOs and error budgets and lead incident response for assigned areas. Explain operating risks and recommended changes to engineering and cross-functional partners and ensure shared understanding. Provide technical guidance and training to associate and intermediate engineers; may delegate work and review work products. Operate assigned platform areas independently and seek leadership guidance for broader reliability, security, financial, or architectural decisions. Experience with Docker/CI-CD, managed Postgres/Redis operations, and application error tracking, plus LLM cost/latency monitoring. Preferred Qualifications Experience with adjacent technical disciplines relevant to the assigned engineering area. Track record of providing training or technical guidance to other employees.
